litigation.mdlName: In re: Depo-Provera (Depot Medroxyprogesterone Acetate) Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Northern District of Florida (Pensacola)

phase: Settlement registration; litigation continues for remaining claims
phaseDetail: Court orders confirm a private settlement program documented in July 2026. CMO 13 appoints BrownGreer as administrator, and CMO 14 identifies November 30, 2026 as the registration deadline. CMO 12 states that the original December Pilot trial was canceled. The court calendar listed a September 18 Rule 702 hearing for ongoing litigation; the public orders page reviewed September 25 does not state an outcome. Eligibility and payments are not automatic.

pendingCounts.scope: Pending actions three months earlier (growth comparison)

defendants: Pharmacia & Upjohn Co. LLC; Pharmacia LLC

settlements.label: Private settlement program
settlements.detail: Court orders confirm a confidential settlement program for eligible Depo-Provera claims, with BrownGreer appointed administrator on August 5, 2026. CMO 14 identifies November 30, 2026 as the registration deadline. The public orders reviewed September 25 do not disclose an aggregate fund or individual payout grid. This is a private agreement, not a class settlement requiring a fairness hearing. Nonparticipating and ineligible claims continue under court procedures.
